narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Multiplying in another order changes the total, so the answer depends on the order.
<bookmark mark='side'/>Count the block again, starting with the side that is two high and five deep.
<bookmark mark='ten'/>That side has ten boxes, and three such slices make the block.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The block did not change, so the boxes cannot change either.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>The same block holds the same boxes, so the order of counting cannot change the total.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. A block is two boxes wide, two high and three deep. Count by the front face, then by the side face. Do the totals match?
